boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ohio University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and market stops with published 2026–27 late availability on or near Ohio University’s Athens campus.

cards.title: Earl's Coop on East Green
cards.subtitle: Shively Hall, East Green • open to midnight Monday–Thursday
cards.notes: Use the Shively Hall counter for chicken tenders, waffle fries, macaroni and cheese, or a vegetarian alternative before its published midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A campus chicken-tender counter with the board’s latest food-service close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Earl's Coop in Shively Hall and publishes Monday–Thursday lunch and dinner hours of 11:00 a.m.–midnight for 2026–27.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–midnight; the page notes it is closed for summer 2026.

cards.title: Maggie Davis Market Express
cards.subtitle: Baker University Center • open 6 a.m.–2 a.m. daily
cards.notes: Head to the Baker Center ground floor for self-checkout snacks, drinks, ready-made meals, essentials, and Ohio University gear until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A daily, on-campus self-checkout market open into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies Maggie Davis Market Express in Baker University Center and lists daily 2026–27 hours of 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours

cards.title: Courtside Pizza
cards.subtitle: Athens • open until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live online-ordering page before going; it lists pizza, wings, and Friday and Saturday service through 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A direct-order pizza stop with published 2 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Courtside Pizza’s direct online-ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published ordering hours include Friday and Saturday, 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; confirm availability on the ordering page before leaving.

cards.title: Shively Commons
cards.subtitle: 59 East Green Drive • open until 10:30 p.m. most days
cards.notes: Use the East Green commons for lunch or dinner during its listed evening window; check the calendar because break and holiday closures are posted.
cards.short_summary: An East Green dining location with service scheduled through 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Shively Commons at 59 East Green Drive and publishes 2026–27 closing times of 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m.; Sunday 5:00–10:30 p.m.; Friday ends at 4 p.m.

cards.title: The Hungry Cat Food Truck
cards.subtitle: Top of Morton Hill • open until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday
cards.notes: Find the university food truck near Morton Hill for American favorites with Southwestern and Asian influences; mobile ordering is available through OHIO Eats.
cards.short_summary: A named campus food truck scheduled until 10 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says The Hungry Cat is usually at the top of Morton Hill and lists 2026–27 Monday–Thursday hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday. Location can vary on campus.

cards.entity_name: Brick City Deli On The Go
cards.title: Brick City Deli On The Go
cards.subtitle: In front of Lindley Hall, South Court Street • until 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Order a made-to-order deli sandwich at the food truck in front of Lindley Hall; use OHIO Eats ahead of a weekday evening visit.
cards.short_summary: A South Court Street food truck with weekday service through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University places Brick City Deli On The Go in front of Lindley Hall on South Court Street and lists Monday–Thursday hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday. Food-truck service may be weather-sensitive.

cards.title: Jefferson Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Hall, 46 East Green Drive • open until 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the East Green marketplace for its market selection or stop by Brick City Deli before its listed 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday close.
cards.short_summary: An East Green marketplace with evening access and multiple food concepts.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Jefferson Marketplace in Jefferson Hall and publishes 2026–27 Monday–Thursday hours of 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 marketplace hours: Monday–Thursday, 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; Friday and weekend service ends at 9 p.m.

cards.title: Boyd Market
cards.subtitle: Boyd Hall, 100 West Green Drive • open until 9 p.m.
cards.notes: Use this West Green market for convenience merchandise or Smooth Moves; the university notes that non-meal-plan market items require Bobcat Cash or a card.
cards.short_summary: A Boyd Hall market with published nightly access through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Boyd Market in Boyd Hall at 100 West Green Drive and publishes 2026–27 hours of 8:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. Monday–Friday.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday, noon–9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Nelson Market
cards.subtitle: Nelson Commons, 10 North McKinley Avenue • until 9 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the South Green market for convenience merchandise, local products, and Fresh Take products, keeping posted university break closures in mind.
cards.short_summary: A South Green market that maintains listed evening hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Nelson Market at 10 North McKinley Avenue and publishes 2026–27 hours ending at 9:00 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday, noon–9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Latitude 39
cards.subtitle: Baker University Center • dinner until 9 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday
cards.notes: Make a dinner reservation or order ahead through OHIO Eats at the Baker Center restaurant; published dinner service runs Tuesday through Saturday evenings.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down Baker Center option with published dinner service until 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University locates Latitude 39 in Baker University Center and publishes 2026–27 dinner hours of 5:00–9:00 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 dinner hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 5:00–9:00 p.m.; closed Sunday and dinner is not listed Monday.
